description: Run a cap's connection test and end-to-end self-test, and record both results on its publishing checklist. Do this after publish_cap, before submit_cap. The connection test sends three requests to base_url + /qumge/ping (correctly signed, wrong secret, and a 10-minute-old timestamp — only the first may succeed); the end-to-end test calls one free and one billable operation directly on the cap (nothing is charged) and, for a route the cap reports itself, waits 2 seconds for its usage report. An MCP cap has each listed tool called once instead. It warns (without blocking) about billed operations that have no `doc`. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as test_app.)
name: test_cap
